records.subject: AGTM
records.title: Agricultural Precision Systems
records.description: Systems for precision agriculture, equipment, software uses, principles, construction, care, tillage, planting, spraying, harvesting, and materials handling machinery. Field trips required.

records.subject: AGTM
records.title: Small Engine Maintenance and Repair
records.description: Safety, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting engines; understanding of engine systems and components including compression, carburetion, cooling, fuel, and lubrication.

records.subject: AGTM
records.title: Agricultural Power Units and Mobile Electrical Systems
records.description: Principles of thermodynamics, engine cycles, transmissions, electrical, starting, braking, steering, suspension systems, differentials and hydraulic systems.

records.subject: AGTM
records.title: Irrigation Systems and Water Management
records.description: Principles of irrigation and drainage, water measurement, irrigation methods and practices, selection of irrigation system components.

records.subject: AGTM
records.title: Electrical Power Systems for Agriculture
records.description: Methods of selecting and installing electrical power circuits in agricultural operations; light frame construction; motor and control circuits; Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs).
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: AGTM
records.title: Methods, Materials, and Machines for Teaching Ag Mechanics
records.description: Development of shop programs in project planning, demonstrations, and skills performance; safety and management of materials, tools, and machines.

records.subject: AGTM
records.title: Advanced Agricultural Precision Systems
records.description: Advanced principles of precision agricultural systems, software uses, management of controllers on equipment, geographical information systems and global positioning systems.

records.subject: AGTM
records.title: Human and Machinery Risk Management
records.description: Legal guidelines and best practices for reducing risk in agricultural settings; topics include equipment, electrical, chemical, livestock, and other hazards around the farm as well as worker protection standards and injury compensation programs; includes an opportunity to prepare and test for a WSDA Private Pesticide Applicators License.

records.subject: AGTM
records.title: Fluid Power Systems
records.description: Fluid power principles applied to the selection, design, operation, and management of agricultural and industrial machinery. Field trips required.

records.subject: AGTM
records.title: Teaching Practicum
records.description: Laboratory and research techniques for AgTM.
